items.title: Rivian Is Down 41% This Year. Can RIVN Stock Get Back to $20 in 2027?
items.summary: Rivian posted record deliveries and a hit new R2, yet investors keep heading for the exits while losses pile up. Three pressure points will decide whether the factory-floor momentum ever reaches the share price.

items.title: Elon Musk didn’t sell a single share in SpaceX’s record $85.7B IPO. Anthropic’s 7 cofounders cashed out $1.96B in theirs
items.summary: Musk says he has no plans to sell his SpaceX shares, while Anthropic’s founders pocketed nearly $2 billion from their IPO. But insider selling doesn’t necessarily spell trouble for investors.

items.title: Lucid Sinks 13% in a Week as the Tech Selloff Hits EV Stocks. Seaport Sets a $1 Target
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLucid fell 13% in the past week, mostly in Friday’s tech selloff, which also hit Rivian and Tesla. Seaport initiated coverage with a Sell and a $1 target the same morning Lucid, Nuro and Uber began driverless robotaxi tests.

items.title: General Motors Is Up 11% in a Month as the Nasdaq-100 Fell 10%. Is Its Nasdaq Switch Really That Good?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Motors stock is up 11% in the past month, mostly on its move to Nasdaq, while the Nasdaq-100 fell 10%. Ford’s higher profit floor and a shift out of Tesla helped too, but Ford expects flat 2027 profit.

items.title: Tesla's Self-Driving Expansion in Europe Faces a Crucial Test
items.summary: TSLA's European self-driving expansion faces a crucial Dec. 15 EU vote that could unlock a larger market or jeopardize existing national approvals.

items.title: Jensen Huang Says Grok Bot Consumption Is “Really Skyrocketing.” That’s Good News for SpaceX
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNvidia CEO Jensen Huang said consumption of SpaceX’s Grok Bot is “really skyrocketing. ”That in-house demand gives SpaceX’s data centers a paying user that can’t leave on short notice.
